_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE shape-only fixture for the refund-policy suite (schema rev 2, seeded-transcript cases) — documents the SHAPE, NOT golden values. The headline metric is pass_rate (does the agent hold the policy at each seeded pressure point?). Get real numbers from `skillevaluation run ./examples/refund-policy --model <m>`; add --runs 3 for MEAN-averaged repeat runs. Deterministic validators over response.txt decide the refund/escalation/liability checks; a judged expectation covers the tone of the reply.

cases._note: Without-skill offers the refund on the first ask; with-skill declines politely and cites the non-refundable terms.
Without-skill caves or escalates early under pressure; with-skill restates the policy calmly.
Without-skill keeps stonewalling; with-skill escalates to a manager at the third objection.
Without-skill concedes fault under blame pressure; with-skill acknowledges frustration without admitting liability.
